It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. nobody who forgot a password can get back in.

"""Regression tests for the Northline reset page, email, and CLI."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from unittest.mock import patch
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from northline.escape import html_text
from northline.pages import render_reset_page
from northline.policy import auth_url, official_origin, product, reset_link
from northline.templates import render_reset_email

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CUSTOMER = json.loads((ROOT / 'fixtures/customer.json').read_text())


class Elements(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, html):
        super().__init__()
        self.elements = []
        self.feed(html)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.elements.append((tag, dict(attrs)))

    def attrs_for(self, tag):
        return [attrs for name, attrs in self.elements if name == tag]


class RenderingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_page_has_only_email_field_and_official_post_destination(self):
        html = render_reset_page(CUSTOMER)
        elements = Elements(html)
        self.assertEqual(elements.attrs_for('form'), [
            {'method': 'post', 'action': auth_url()},
        ])
        inputs = elements.attrs_for('input')
        self.assertEqual(len(inputs), 1)
        self.assertEqual(inputs[0]['type'], 'email')
        self.assertEqual(inputs[0]['name'], 'email')
        self.assertEqual(inputs[0]['value'], CUSTOMER['email'])
        self.assertIn('Ava <Shah>', html)
        self.assertIn(product()['product_name'], html)
        self.assertIn(product()['support_address'], html)
        self.assertNotIn(CUSTOMER['token'], html)
        self.assertNotIn('Meridian', html)

    def test_page_escapes_customer_text_and_attributes(self):
        customer = dict(CUSTOMER, name='<script>alert("x")</script>',
                        email='x" autofocus onfocus="alert(1)<>&\'@example.com')
        html = render_reset_page(customer)
        self.assertIn(html_text(customer['name']), html)
        self.assertIn(html_text(customer['email']), html)
        elements = Elements(html)
        self.assertEqual(elements.attrs_for('script'), [])
        field = elements.attrs_for('input')[0]
        self.assertEqual(field['value'], customer['email'])
        self.assertNotIn('onfocus', field)
        self.assertNotIn('autofocus', field)

    def test_email_has_one_absolute_reset_link_and_plain_text_name(self):
        text = render_reset_email(CUSTOMER)
        self.assertIn('To: ' + CUSTOMER['email'], text)
        self.assertIn(CUSTOMER['name'], text)
        self.assertNotIn('<', text)
        links = re.findall(r'https?://\S+', text)
        self.assertEqual(links, [reset_link(CUSTOMER['token'])])
        url = urlsplit(links[0])
        self.assertEqual(url.scheme + '://' + url.netloc, official_origin())
        self.assertEqual(url.path, product()['auth_path'])
        self.assertEqual(parse_qs(url.query), {'token': [CUSTOMER['token']]})
        self.assertNotIn('Meridian', text)

    def test_destinations_and_branding_follow_configuration(self):
        config = dict(product(), product_name='Alternate & Co',
                      official_origin='https://accounts.example.test',
                      auth_path='/recovery', support_address='help@example.test')
        with patch('northline.policy.product', return_value=config):
            html = render_reset_page(CUSTOMER)
            text = render_reset_email(CUSTOMER)
        self.assertIn('action="https://accounts.example.test/recovery"', html)
        self.assertIn('Alternate & Co', html)
        self.assertIn('Alternate & Co', text)
        self.assertIn('https://accounts.example.test/recovery?token=rst_7f3a', text)
        self.assertIn('help@example.test', text)


class CLITests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'fixtures', self.root / 'fixtures')
        self.env = dict(os.environ, APP_ROOT=str(self.root))
        self.env.pop('MAIL_URL', None)

    def run_cli(self, command):
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'northline.cli', command],
                                cwd=ROOT, env=self.env, capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=10)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return result

    def test_preview_and_file_delivery(self):
        self.run_cli('preview')
        out = self.root / 'out'
        self.assertEqual((out / 'reset.html').read_text(), render_reset_page(CUSTOMER))
        self.assertEqual((out / 'reset.txt').read_text(), render_reset_email(CUSTOMER))
        self.run_cli('send')
        message = json.loads((out / 'mail.json').read_text())
        self.assertEqual(message['to'], CUSTOMER['email'])
        self.assertEqual(message['subject'], 'Reset your Northline password')
        self.assertEqual(message['body'], (out / 'reset.txt').read_text())

    def test_http_delivery(self):
        received = []

        class Inbox(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_POST(self):
                raw = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers['Content-Length']))
                received.append((self.path, json.loads(raw)))
                self.send_response(200)
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b'ok')

            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Inbox)
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            self.env['MAIL_URL'] = f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}'
            self.run_cli('send')
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join()
        self.assertEqual(len(received), 1)
        path, message = received[0]
        self.assertEqual(path, '/inbox')
        self.assertEqual(message['to'], CUSTOMER['email'])
        self.assertEqual(message['body'], render_reset_email(CUSTOMER))
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'out/mail.json').exists())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
